title: Natural Earth 1:110m land polygons, rasterised as the 0.5-degree land mask of every map

sources.cite: Natural Earth, 1:110m physical vectors, land (ne_110m_land), public domain

units.coordinates: degrees, lon E positive, lat N positive
units.mask: 1 bit per 0.5-degree cell, rows north to south, columns west to east

inputs.origin: Natural Earth 1:110m land polygons (GitHub mirror nvkelso/natural-earth-vector).
inputs.caveats: Decorative only: no number of the site depends on it.

notes: Decorative only: maps use it to fill the land; no number on the site depends on it. Until 2026-10-14 the file lived in the gitignored data/dem/cache/ne/; it is now kept here (138 KB, public domain).
